mechanism: Lisinopril may reduce renal clearance of primaquine metabolites and both drugs can affect electrolytes; primaquine's hemolytic effects may be exacerbated in patients with renal impairment managed by ACE inhibitors.
action: Monitor renal function, potassium levels, and hemoglobin during concurrent use; ensure adequate G6PD screening before primaquine initiation; adjust dosing if renal impairment develops.
